what: Both real Maker Arms now follow Table 10 from the web panel: Turn arms ON, Move up, Go to idle and Turn arms OFF all work on the physical arms.
why: User request: one-click web control of the real arms. Root cause of the motor dropouts was both USB-CAN adapters sharing one process; one service process per arm fixes it.
details: Proof: the SDK's own maker-arm check held all motors on the same arm; our service with a single adapter per process then drove cleanly.
Two-arm web test: real arms within 2.6 deg of Unreal while moving, 0 CAN errors, clean return and release on Turn arms OFF.
The page shows a live real-arm log for debugging.
